dvrManifests.description: Required. A list of DVR manifests. Currently only one DVR manifest is allowed.

outputURI.description: Output only. The output URI of the DVR manifest. The DVR output will be placed in a directory named `dvr/dvrSessionId/` under the parent channel's output uri. Format: {channel.output.uri}/dvr/{dvrSessionId}/{channel.manifests.fileName} Example: gs://my-bucket/outputs/dvr/my-dvr-session/main.m3u8

error.description: Output only. An error object that describes the reason for the failure. This property only presents when `state` is `FAILED`.

message.description: A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the [google.rpc.Status.details][google.rpc.Status.details] field, or localized by the client.

state.description: Output only. The state of the clip.
